messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: numericInput in firefox
parts: The numericInput simply tells the browser to display <input type="number">, whatever the browser decides that means is what the user gets. In the future we may add some more specific behaviors, especially around validation, but we don't have it today.
